ModMetaData.name: Forced Commitment Mode
ModMetaData.author: Riketta
ModMetaData.description:
Enforces a true commitment mode playstyle: the game autosaves the instant anything risky happens - raids, downed or killed pawns, mental breaks, fires and more - so no outcome can be reloaded away, and closing or crashing the game can no longer dodge a save. Every trigger can be toggled in the mod settings; all are on by default.
While a commitment mode save is running, all debug buttons except the log window are hidden and god mode is switched off. Other saves stay untouched unless the optional non-commitment setting is enabled, which adds the event autosaves there as well.
Safe to add and remove at any time - nothing is saved to the game state.
Source code & details: https://github.com/Riketta/ForcedCommitmentMode
